home.meta_title: Hanpu Li · writing, film criticism, photography and systems
home.meta_description: Hanpu Li is a writer and researcher in London working across film criticism, poetry, photography, spatial evidence and small software systems.
home.eyebrow: writing / film criticism / photos / code · london
home.education: York · English Language and Linguistics · film · QMUL
home.lede: I watch films. I also write ci.
home.lede_note: ci, not cis. Neither am I.
home.intro: Most of my work starts with writing: criticism, research, poetry. I also make photographs, and build software when a method needs a tool.
home.method: I care about what gets recorded, what gets left out, and whether the evidence actually supports the claim.

ci.meta_description: Ci by Hanpu Li: Sixteen Poems of A and B, its out-of-cycle appendix, and a separate pair dated 9 September 2026, with Chinese source text and translations.
ci.heading: Sixteen Poems of A and B
ci.subtitle: A sixteen-poem cycle written by one author in two voices, A (甲) and B (乙). A usually gives a detailed prefatory account; B’s first five poems are untitled. The cycle is dated 9 June 2026. One out-of-cycle poem dated 1 July follows as an appendix. The author’s annotations are available on request.
ci.footer: annotations to Sixteen Poems of A and B available on request
ci.page_subtitle: Two distinct groups of ci, with the Chinese source text and translation shown together where applicable.
ci.separate_note: A separate pair, not part of Sixteen Poems of A and B.
